description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Aquilan Shield — GILDED GUARDIANS (WP-C46): each time a ranged attack targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (not MONSTER / VEHICLE) within range of an objective marker, if the Strength of that attack is greater than the target's Toughness, subtract 1 from the wound roll. Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks active, P2 Custodes); setup: P2 detachment Aquilan Shield, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation, seeded dice, Custodian Guard Delta (T7) moved up to y=1316 px so it stands within range of the centre objective (not engaged). Shooting phase: a real click selects the Tankbustas, Quick-Assign at Custodian Guard Delta, Confirm, resolve: the busta rokkits (S10 / S12 > T7) roll to wound with -1 named 'Gilded Guardians (Aquilan Shield)' in the ranged wound block's modifier ledger and the Dice Log.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description); the target stands within range of an objective marker
the defender's enemy_targets_unit_shooting window (not under test)
Gilded Guardians named in a ranged wound block's modifier ledger
